episode_summary: In this episode, mindset coach Paul Salter discusses the pitfalls of success driven by the need to prove oneself. He highlights the importance of recalibrating ambition to focus on sustainable, fulfillment-driven achievement rather than external validation. Salter provides actionable insights for high achievers to separate their self-worth from professional success, ultimately leading to a more balanced and fulfilling life.
